sn16.4:1.3: Kathaṃrūpo bhikkhu arahati kulūpako hotuṃ || Kathaṃrūpo bhikkhu na arahati kulūpako hotunti || || 3
sn16.4:2.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃcitto kulāni upasaṅkamati || ||
sn16.4:2.7: Tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃcittassa kulāni upasaṅkamato na denti tena bhikkhu sandiyyati || so tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassam paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn16.4:2.10: dandham denti no sīghaṃ || tena bhikkhu sandiyyati || so tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn16.4:2.11: asakaccaṃ denti no sakkaccaṃ || tena bhikkhu sandiyyati || so tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati || ||
sn16.4:2.12: Evarūpo kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na arahati kudūpako hotuṃ || || 6
sn16.4:3.1: Yo ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃcitto kulāni upasaṅkamati ||
sn16.4:3.7: sakkaccaññeva me dentu mā asakkaccan ti || || 7
sn16.4:3.8: Tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃcittassa kulāni upasaṅkamato na denti || tena bhikkhu na sandiyyati || so na tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn16.4:3.12: asakkaccaṃ denti no sakkaccaṃ || tena bhikkhu na sandiyyati || so na tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati || ||
sn16.4:3.13: Evarūpo kho bhikkhave bhikkhu arahati kulūpako hotuṃ || || 8
sn16.4:4.8: Tassa ce bhikkhave Kassapassa evaṃ cittassa kulāni upasaṅkamato na denti || tena Kassapo pi na sandiyyati || so na tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn16.4:4.9: thokaṃ denti no bahukaṃ || tena Kassapo na sandiyyati || so na tato nidānam dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn16.4:4.10: lukham denti no paṇītaṃ || tena Kassapo na sandiyyati || so na tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati ||
sn16.4:4.11: dandhaṃ denti no sīghaṃ || tena Kassapo na sandiyyati || so na tato nidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati || ||
sn16.4:4.12: asakkaccaṃ denti no sakkaccaṃ || tena Kassapo no sandiyyati || so na tato nidānam dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati || || 10
sn16.4:4.13: Kassapena vā hi bhikkhave ovadissāmi yo vā panassa kassapasadiso || ovāditehi ca pana vo tathattāya paṭipajjitabbanti || ||
